arxiv-1612-04828.title: Optimal Quantum Metrology of Distant Black Bodies
arxiv-1612-04828.creator: Mark E. Pearce, Earl T. Campbell, Pieter Kok
arxiv-1612-04828.description: Abstract Measurements of an object’s temperature are important in many disciplines, from astronomy to engineering, as are estimates of an object’s spatial configuration. We present the quantum optimal estimator for the temperature of a distant body based on the black body radiation received in the far-field.

arxiv-2107-10450.title: Learning Sparse Fixed-Structure Gaussian Bayesian Networks
arxiv-2107-10450.creator: Arnab Bhattcharyya, Davin Choo, Rishikesh Gajjala, Sutanu Gayen, Yuhao Wang
arxiv-2107-10450.description: Abstract Gaussian Bayesian networks (a.k.a. linear Gaussian structural equation models) are widely used to model causal interactions among continuous variables. In this work, we study the problem of learning a fixed-structure Gaussian Bayesian network up to a bounded error in total variation distance.

arxiv-2303-12586.title: Phonon-Assisted Tunneling through Quantum Dot Systems Connected to Majorana Bound States
arxiv-2303-12586.creator: Levente Máthé, Zoltán Kovács-Krausz, Ioan Botiz, Ioan Grosu, Khadija El Anouz, Abderrahim El Allati, Liviu P. Zârbo
arxiv-2303-12586.description: Abstract We theoretically analyze phonon-assisted tunneling transport in a quantum dot side connected to a Majorana bound state in a topological superconducting nanowire. We investigate the behavior of the current through the dot, for a range of experimentally relevant parameters, in the presence of one long-wave optical phonon mode.

arxiv-2306-08719.title: Off-policy Evaluation in Doubly Inhomogeneous Environments
arxiv-2306-08719.creator: Zeyu Bian, Chengchun Shi, Zhengling Qi, Lan Wang
arxiv-2306-08719.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zeyu Bian, Chengchun Shi, Zhengling Qi, Lan Wang. This work aims to study off-policy evaluation (OPE) under scenarios where two key reinforcement learning (RL) assumptions – temporal stationarity and individual homogeneity are both violated. To handle the “double inhomogeneities”, we propose a class of latent factor models for the reward and transition functions, under which we develop a general OPE framework that consists of both model-based and model-free approaches.

arxiv-2311-12213.title: Evolutionary Equations are G G -compact
arxiv-2311-12213.creator: Krešimir Burazin, Marko Erceg, and Marcus Waurick
arxiv-2311-12213.description: Abstract Abstract We prove a compactness result related to G G -convergence for autonomous evolutionary equations in the sense of Picard. Compared to previous work related to applications, we do not require any boundedness or regularity of the underlying spatial domain; nor do we assume any periodicity or ergodicity assumption on the potentially oscillatory part.

arxiv-2409-06609.title: Improving the Precision of CNNs for Magnetic Resonance Spectral Modeling
arxiv-2409-06609.creator: John LaMaster, Dhritiman Das, Florian Kofler, Jason Crane, Yan Li, Tobias Lasser, Bjoern H Menze
arxiv-2409-06609.description: Abstract Magnetic resonance spectroscopic imaging is a widely available imaging modality that can non-invasively provide a metabolic profile of the tissue of interest, yet is challenging to integrate clinically. One major reason is the expensive, expert data processing and analysis that is required.

arxiv-2501-13394.title: Concurrent Reinforcement Learning with Aggregated States via Randomized Least Squares Value Iteration
arxiv-2501-13394.creator: Yan Chen, Qinxun Bai, Yiteng Zhang, Maria Dimakopoulou, Shi Dong, Qi Sun, Zhengyuan Zhou
arxiv-2501-13394.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yan Chen, Qinxun Bai, Yiteng Zhang, Maria Dimakopoulou, Shi Dong, Qi Sun, Zhengyuan Zhou. Designing learning agents that explore efficiently in a complex environment has been widely recognized as a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning. While a number of works have demonstrated the effectiveness of techniques based on randomized value functions on a single agent, it remains unclear, from a theoretical point of view, whether injecting randomization can help a society of agents concurently explore an environment.

arxiv-2502-13340.title: A Python Toolkit for Plotting Double Star Observations with 1:1 Aspect Ratio
arxiv-2502-13340.creator: Xinyue Wang
arxiv-2502-13340.description: Abstract Accurate visualization of double star astrometric data is essential for effective analysis and interpretation. This article presents a Python toolkit designed for astronomers who need to plot measurements from diverse sources—historical, Gaia DR3, and the Las Cumbres Observatory (LCO) network—while maintaining a 1:1 aspect ratio to avoid visually distorting the data.

arxiv-2512-05735.title: Sliding phasons in Moiré Ladders
arxiv-2512-05735.creator: Paula Mellado, Francisco Muñoz, Javiera Cabezas-Escares
arxiv-2512-05735.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Paula Mellado, Francisco Muñoz, Javiera Cabezas-Escares. An incommensurate charge density wave is a periodic modulation of charge that breaks translational symmetry at a momentum that does not coincide with the primitive lattice vectors. Its Goldstone excitation, the phason, comprises collective gapless phase fluctuations.

pmc-10634188.title: Rapid and non-destructive identification of Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles arabiensis mosquito species using Raman spectroscopy via machine learning classification models
pmc-10634188.creator: Dickson L Omucheni, Kenneth A Kaduki, Wolfgang R Mukabana
pmc-10634188.description: BackgroundIdentification of malaria vectors is an important exercise that can result in the deployment of targeted control measures and monitoring the susceptibility of the vectors to control strategies. Although known to possess distinct biting behaviours and habitats, the African malaria vectors Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles arabiensis are morphologically indistinguishable and are known to be discriminated by molecular techniques.

pmc-10686426.title: Vaccination against the HDL receptor of S. japonicum inhibits egg embryonation and prevents fatal hepatic complication in rabbit model
pmc-10686426.creator: Jifeng Zhu, Lina Zhang, Zechao Xue, Zilüe Li, Chun Wang, Fanyan Chen, Yalin Li, Yang Dai, Yonghua Zhou, Sha Zhou, Xiaojun Chen, Kuniko Okumura-Noji, Rui Lu, Shinji Yokoyama, Chuan Su
pmc-10686426.description: BackgroundSchistosomiasis is one of the most important neglected tropical infectious diseases to overcome and the primary cause of its pathogenesis is ectopic maturation of the parasite eggs. Uptake of cholesteryl ester from the host high-density lipoprotein (HDL) is a key in this process in Schistosoma japonicum and CD36-related protein (CD36RP) has been identified as the receptor for this reaction.

pmc-11330498.title: The feedback loop between MTA1 and MTA3/TRIM21 modulates stemness of breast cancer in response to estrogen
pmc-11330498.creator: Jingyao Zhang, Yinuo Wang, Jingjing Zhang, Xin Wang, Jiaxiang Liu, Miaomiao Huo, Ting Hu, Tianyu Ma, Die Zhang, Yu Li, Chang Guo, Yunkai Yang, Min Zhang, Baowen Yuan, Hao Qin, Xu Teng, Tianyang Gao, Xinhui Hao, Hefen Yu, Wei Huang, Binghe Xu, Yan Wang
pmc-11330498.description: The metastasis-associated protein (MTA) family plays a crucial role in the development of breast cancer, a common malignancy with a high incidence rate among women. However, the mechanism by which each member of the MTA family contributes to breast cancer progression is poorly understood.

pmc-11487844.title: Implementing a remote self-screening programme for atrial fibrillation using digital health technology among community-dwellers aged 75 years and older: a qualitative evaluation
pmc-11487844.creator: Kam Cheong Wong, Tu N Nguyen, Steven A Trankle, Tim Usherwood, Desi Quintans, Simone Marschner, Samual Turnbull, Anupama Balasuriya Indrawansa, Rose White, Mason Jenner Burns, Vishal Gopal, Richard I Lindley, Saurabh Kumar, Clara K Chow
pmc-11487844.description: ObjectiveTo examine the feasibility of implementing remote atrial fibrillation (AF) self-screening among older people supported by a remote central monitoring system.DesignProcess evaluation of the Mass AF randomised clinical trial (ACTRN12621000184875) with one-to-one semistructured interviews using interview guides underpinned by the Critical Realism approach and coded using the UK Medical Research Council Guidance of Process Evaluation Framework.

pmc-11523896.title: Measuring health-related quality of life in a Chinese Mainland adolescent population: psychometric properties of the Mandarin Chinese self-reported KIDSCREEN-27 and KIDSCREEN-10 index
pmc-11523896.creator: Juan Li, Yuhang Zhu, Gaopei Zhu, Zhenliang Qiu, Jinling Wang, Anne Kaman, Michael Erhart, Adekunle Adedeji, Yongye Liu, Di Wu, Ulrike Ravens-Sieberer, Juan Li, Juan Li, Yuhang Zhu, Di Wu, Johan Yau Yin Ng, Yinghua Ma, Hanrong Wu, Yizhen Yu, Yuantao Hao, Hongmei Wang, Huijing Shi, Taisheng Cai, Yanbo
pmc-11523896.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe self-reported KIDSCREEN questionnaires are ideal for capturing children’s and adolescents’ health-related quality of life (HRQoL) and have gained worldwide popularity. Responding to demands for the concise nature of KIDSCREEN among Chinese Mainland researchers and practitioners, this study aimed to evaluate the psychometric properties of the Mandarin Chinese self-reported KIDSCREEN-27 (KS-27) and KIDSCREEN-10 index (KS-10), which are short versions of the self-reported KIDSCREEN-52 (KS-52).MethodsThis study reanalyzed the validation dataset of the Mandarin Chinese self-reported KS-52.

pmc-13013766.title: Dermatologists’ Perspectives and Real-World Assessment of Alopecia Areata Severity in Adults in Taiwan: A Cross-sectional Survey
pmc-13013766.creator: Chih-Chiang Chen, Chao-Chun Yang, Sung-Jan Lin, Jenny Austin, Samantha K. Kurosky, Kent Hanson, Melody Yen, Peter Anderson, Gerardo A. Encinas, Juliana M. Canosa, Simran Marwaha, Wen-Hung Chung
pmc-13013766.description: IntroductionAlopecia areata (AA) is an autoimmune disease characterized by nonscarring hair loss that may impact quality of life (QoL). After 2021, new therapies were approved to treat severe AA in Taiwan; however, there is no global definition of severe AA. Dermatologists may use other criteria in addition to scalp hair loss (SHL) when estimating severity.

pmc-13533341.title: Adaptation of the Quick Aphasia Battery into Urdu and establishment of its psychometric properties
pmc-13533341.creator: Abeeha Fatima, Anum Ashraf, Muhammad Azzam Khan
pmc-13533341.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Quick Aphasia Battery provides a quick yet comprehensive evaluation of language performance in individuals with aphasia. While the tool was originally developed in English, no validated Urdu version existed for use in Pakistani clinical settings. This study aimed to translate and culturally adapt the Urdu version of the Quick Aphasia Battery and determine its psychometric properties, including reliability and preliminary diagnostic performance among stroke patients. The study was conducted in three phases.

uslaw-usc-t18-s217.title: 18 U.S.C. § 217 — Acceptance of consideration for adjustment of farm indebtedness
uslaw-usc-t18-s217.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s217.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 11 (Bribery, Graft, And Conflicts Of Interest). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whoever, being an officer or employee of, or person acting for the United States or any agency thereof, accepts any fee, commission, gift, or other consideration in connection with the compromise, adjustment, or cancellation of any farm.
